sources.primaryRuntime: GET /matches and GET /matches/{matchId} using legitimate guest flow

ScheduledMatch.note: Catch-all for non-live/non-terminal statuses. It is not semantically identical to raw status 'programado'.

FinalizedMatch.warning: Because 'cancelado' is terminal in the client classifier, hasStarted must not be reused as proof that a cancelled match was actually played.

separateDimensions.matchLifecycle: Use raw match status plus client lifecycle classification.
separateDimensions.sheetLifecycle: Keep matchSheetStatus separately; it tracks the digital match sheet workflow.
separateDimensions.resultAvailability: Determine separately from the presence/validity of result fields. Never infer from date alone.
separateDimensions.history: Reprogrammed/suspended are transitions that may later become finalized; preserve evidence/history instead of forcing one permanent label.

recommendedDerivedModel.disputadoConfirmado: boolean/tri-state derived from positive play evidence; not a raw LarrySport status

safeRules: null score never implies suspendido or no-show
programming PDF proves scheduling, not that the match was played
reprogramming publication proves a schedule revision, not the current terminal state
status finalizado/finalized may mark the match as finished, but score availability still depends on result
cancelado is terminal but is not proof of having been played
suspendido alone does not prove whether play had already started
unknown raw status or ambiguous identity => no automatic update

idRelations.matchId: match.id; canonical match key for detail and subresources
idRelations.teamId: nested home/away team id and /matches filter
idRelations.matchSheetId: observed in RefereeByMatch and CoachingStaffByMatch alongside matchId; not proven to be PDF/planilla document id
idRelations.multidivisionId: competition-level relation; not confirmed as direct top-level match field

identityRequired: otherwise unique, non-ambiguous reconciliation scoped by tournament/team/date only for preview
dryRunGate.stateRequired: recognized raw status or explicit official public evidence
dryRunGate.scoreRequiredForResultAvailable: result object with both team scores, or an independently official match-sheet/result source
